method.timing: Actual refreshSummary through COMMIT/optimize and full public query API return; no process startup, copy, append, source restore or correctness checks inside timers.
method.reads: Warm cache; fixed 2026 calendar interval; limit100/offset0; three request sorts, costs on/off, provider/model, all four categories as one consumer operation. All-page averages are also measured separately.
method.instrumentation: SQL diagnostics use a separate invocation after timed read samples. Baseline-only refresh captures SQL execution and includes wrapper overhead; full A/B refresh does not capture SQL execution timings. Product StageProfiler retains every nested storage field. Overlapping timers are not summed.
method.rankings: Read operations ranked separately from storage peer stages. Different user operations/frequencies are not a single combined bottleneck ranking.
method.cache: OS cache uncontrolled; no forced GC or cache reset. Each variant/trial uses a fresh process and new DB; empty rollup activation occurs before refresh timing.
method.billing: Largest accepted Codex session; api/subscription/unknown each time starts from restored original selection and costs. Timing includes public setSessionBilling through COMMIT; restore and result checks are outside timers.
method.correctness: A/B semantic facts and public result hashes; raw/rollup10 dimensions; independent JS provider/model token means for four groups with empty usage both included/excluded; +1request/+130tokens, prior rows unchanged, unchanged refresh skip, FK/integrity.
method.limitations: No independent parser oracle for private real logs, UI/extension-host IPC/network/quota/heap peak or hostile cancellation cases. Generated synthetic logs are ordinary deterministic requests; capability density is reported rather than manufactured.

    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,

      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,

      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, 
  coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription' THEN 0
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'api' THEN m.estimated_cost_usd
  END AS cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription'

    THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS unknown_costs

    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id

        SELECT NULL AS period
        FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) AS turn_summary
        WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
        GROUP BY provider, model, project_key, session_id
    )

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      project_key,
      (
        SELECT project_name
        FROM projects p
        WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key
      ) AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, 
  coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription' THEN 0
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'api' THEN m.estimated_cost_usd
  END AS cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription'
      OR c.billing_mode = 'api' AND m.estimated_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
    THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS unknown_costs
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, model, project_key
    )
    ORDER BY coalesce(model, '') = '', project_name IS NULL, project_name DESC, provider, model, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

SELECT
        *,
        (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AS has_recorded_usage
      FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      p.project_name,
      s.session_name
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t
  ) t
    JOIN projects p ON p.project_key = t.project_key
    JOIN sessions s ON s.provider = t.provider AND s.session_id = t.session_id
  ) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL) AND id > ?
      ORDER BY started_at_ms IS NULL, started_at_ms IS NULL, started_at_ms DESC, provider, id
      LIMIT ?
      OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode, COUNT(*) OVER() AS _total
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      c.cost_usd,
      coalesce(c.unknown_costs, 1) AS unknown_costs,
      coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, period
    )
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, period IS NULL, period DESC, provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (

      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,

      NULL AS session_id,

      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      c.cost_usd,
      coalesce(c.unknown_costs, 1) AS unknown_costs,
      coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, period
    )
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, period IS NULL, period DESC, provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

        WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_write_input_tokens,

  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,

    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens

    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens

  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')

  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,

  CASE

    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, 
  coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription' THEN 0
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'api' THEN m.estimated_cost_usd
  END AS cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription'

    THEN 0
    ELSE 1

    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)

        CASE WHEN ? = 'subscription' THEN 0 WHEN ? = 'api' THEN sum(estimated_cost_usd) END,
        CASE
          WHEN ? = 'subscription' THEN 0
          WHEN ? = 'api' THEN max(1, count(*)) - count(estimated_cost_usd)
          ELSE max(1, count(*))
        END, ?
      FROM turn_model_usage

        (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AS has_recorded_usage
      FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      p.project_name,
      s.session_name
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, 
  coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription' THEN 0
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'api' THEN m.estimated_cost_usd
  END AS cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription'
      OR c.billing_mode = 'api' AND m.estimated_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
    THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS unknown_costs
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
    JOIN projects p ON p.project_key = t.project_key
    JOIN sessions s ON s.provider = t.provider AND s.session_id = t.session_id
  ) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL) AND id > ?
      ORDER BY (started_at_ms IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), started_at_ms IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', started_at_ms IS NULL, started_at_ms DESC, provider, model, id
      LIMIT ?
      OFFSET ?

SELECT

        (
          SELECT project_name
          FROM projects p
          WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key
        ) AS project_name,
        NULL AS provider,
        NULL AS session_id,
        NULL AS session_name,
        NULL AS session_started_at_ms, COUNT(*) OVER() AS _total
      FROM turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?)
      GROUP BY project_key
      ORDER BY 
        project_name COLLATE NOCASE, project_key
      LIMIT ?
      OFFSET ?

SELECT
        project_key,
        (
          SELECT project_name
          FROM projects p
          WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key
        ) AS project_name,
        provider AS provider,
        session_id AS session_id,
        (
        SELECT session_name
        FROM sessions s
        WHERE s.provider = turn_summary.provider AND s.session_id = turn_summary.session_id
      ) AS session_name,
        MIN(started_at_ms) AS session_started_at_ms, COUNT(*) OVER() AS _total
      FROM turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?)
      GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id
      ORDER BY COALESCE(session_name, '이름 없는 세션') COLLATE NOCASE, provider,
        project_name COLLATE NOCASE, project_key, session_started_at_ms, session_id
      LIMIT ?
      OFFSET ?

SELECT
          provider,
          category,
          name,
          sum(usage_count) AS usage_count,
          count(*) OVER() AS _total,
          sum(sum(usage_count)) OVER() AS _totalUses,
          max(sum(usage_count)) OVER() AS _maxUses
        FROM (
    SELECT
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.started_at_ms,
      u.category,
      u.name,
      u.usage_count
    FROM turn_summary t
    JOIN turn_capability_usage u ON u.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
        WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL) AND category = ?
        GROUP BY provider, name
        ORDER BY name = '', usage_count DESC, provider, name
        LIMIT ?
        OFFSET ?

SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS files,
        COALESCE(SUM(processing_status = 'processing'), 0) AS processing,
        COALESCE(SUM(processing_status = 'done'), 0) AS done,
        COALESCE(SUM(processing_status = 'error'), 0) AS error,
        COALESCE(SUM(processing_status = 'interrupted'), 0) AS interrupted,
        (
          SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM turn_summary
          WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND last_error IS NOT NULL
        ) AS stale_summaries
      FROM manifest
      WHERE provider IN (?,?)

INSERT OR REPLACE INTO turn_costs
        SELECT t.id, ?, 
  CASE WHEN ? = 'subscription' THEN 0 WHEN ? = 'api' THEN sum(estimated_cost_usd) END,
  CASE
    WHEN ? = 'subscription' THEN 0
    WHEN ? = 'api' THEN max(1, count(*)) - count(estimated_cost_usd)
    ELSE max(1, count(*))
  END, ?
        FROM turn_summary t
        LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage u ON u.turn_id = t.id
        WHERE t.provider = ? AND t.session_id = ?
        GROUP BY t.id

INSERT INTO session_billing VALUES (?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(provider, session_id) DO UPDATE SET billing_mode = excluded.billing_mode

SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULLIF(local_day, '') AS period,
      SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(r_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(r_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(r_duration_ms_known), 0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(r_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(r_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns

      session_id,
      local_day,
      input_tokens,

        WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_write_input_tokens,

        WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)

      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(r_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(r_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE

      SUM(r_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns
    FROM (
      SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      session_id,
      local_day,
      input_tokens,
      output_tokens,
      total_tokens,
      turn_count,
      completed_turns,
      recorded_turns,
      recorded_completed_turns,
      cache_write_input_tokens,
      cache_write_input_tokens_known,

      project_key,
      (
        SELECT project_name
        FROM projects p
        WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key
      ) AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode, COUNT(*) OVER() AS _total
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      c.cost_usd,
      coalesce(c.unknown_costs, 1) AS unknown_costs,
      coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, project_key
    )
    ORDER BY project_name IS NULL, project_name DESC, provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

    )

    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

      project_key,
      (
        SELECT project_name
        FROM projects p
        WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key
      ) AS project_name,
      session_id,
      (
        SELECT session_name
        FROM sessions s
        WHERE s.provider = turn_summary.provider AND s.session_id = turn_summary.session_id
      ) AS session_name,
      (
        SELECT MIN(t.started_at_ms)
        FROM turn_summary t
        WHERE t.provider = turn_summary.provider AND t.session_id = turn_summary.session_id
      ) AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      c.cost_usd,
      coalesce(c.unknown_costs, 1) AS unknown_costs,
      coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id
    )
    ORDER BY session_started_at_ms IS NULL, session_started_at_ms DESC, provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,

      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,

    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))

  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,

    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,

      1.0 * SUM(r_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_output_tokens,

          WHEN ? = 'api' THEN max(1, count(*)) - count(estimated_cost_usd)
          ELSE max(1, count(*))
        END, ?
      FROM turn_model_usage
      WHERE turn_id = ?

        LIMIT ?

INSERT OR REPLACE INTO turn_costs
        SELECT t.id, ?, 
  CASE WHEN ? = 'subscription' THEN 0 WHEN ? = 'api' THEN sum(estimated_cost_usd) END,
  CASE
    WHEN ? = 'subscription' THEN 0
    WHEN ? = 'api' THEN max(1, count(*)) - count(estimated_cost_usd)
    ELSE max(1, count(*))
  END, ?
        FROM turn_summary t
        LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage u ON u.turn_id = t.id
        WHERE t.provider = ? AND t.session_id = ?
        GROUP BY t.id
